**Source** [Wake the Dead #4](/Sources.aspx?ID=219) pg. 29 **Traditions** [Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4) **Cast** [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284) **Area** 20-foot emanation **Saving Throw** Will --- You chant a marching song of Yled to empower the undead and terrify the living. Undead creatures within the area gain the [quickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=32) condition for 1 minute, which they can use only to Stride.
Living creatures in the area must attempt a Will save. This gains the [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60), [_fear_](/Spells.aspx?ID=110), and [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106) traits for living creatures. **Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** The creature is [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19) 1.
**Failure** The creature is [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19) 2.
**Critical Failure** The creature is [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19) 3 and [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28) for 1 round.
